serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
'Nun' Shanice: Welcome back! Did you see what happened to Priestbot?! He is bugging out of the wazoo! This is terrible!
You: Yeah… I was kinda there when he broke.
'Nun' Shanice: Really?! 
You: Y-yeah. It’s not my fault by the way! I asked him about the new pope and then he started bragging about an update or something and seconds later he was like this.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceThinking
'Nun' Shanice: An update… What could this mean… 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
'Nun' Shanice: Oh, right, I already opened him up and checked his hardware. There were some surprises, some bigger than others, MUCH bigger, but everything should work fine. Lots of dust tho.
You: Are you sure it’s safe for you to repair him? You could make things worse.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
'Nun' Shanice: How rude! I’m studying computer science at a local university, you know?!
You: M-my bad! 
You: I don’t know about this stuff much, I only search the net and play video games on my PC.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
